findings.evidence: src/advice/postflop.ts:197-199 computes impliedRequiredEquityPct on any street (no street check), and :249 calls when equityPct >= impliedRequiredEquityPct. 'Counting your outs' only partly covers this. The user approved this wording in Q-2, so it is recorded here, not sent back.

findings.issue: The A-5 flop-raise justification says a hand below the 65% bar 'should just call or fold by the pot-odds rules (value-raise, pot-odds-call)'. The implied-odds rule can also decide, and docs/advice/postflop-rules.md:112 says such a hand 'is called or folded by the pot-odds and implied-odds rules'.
findings.evidence: src/advice/postflop.ts:246-255. The rule is pot-odds-call, then implied-odds-call, then pot-odds-fold.
findings.fix: Because A-5 is the spec writer's assumption, the user can change it: '... by the pot-odds and implied-odds rules (value-raise, pot-odds-call, implied-odds-call).' Update the test constant and the docs cell to match.

summary: All seven fields match the approved section 5 texts exactly, in both the data and the docs table (the word-diff shows only those cells changed). Nothing changed outside the spec. Checked against src/advice/postflop.ts: the turn price counts the river bet ((call+R)/(pot+call+2R), which raises the price, so the turn-call justification is right); pot-odds-call uses >=; value-raise is a strict > 65 against the calling range; check-free gives a free turn only if no one bets after you. All of these are stated correctly. The new test pins each text with toBe on LEAK_CATEGORIES, checks shape and escape characters on the loaded fields, scans every postflop entry and the docs for the removed phrases, and ties 65 to VALUE_RAISE_THRESHOLD_PCT, so a wrong or missing text fails it. It passes (5/5) and the fix-2 gate passes. The two MINOR wording gaps both concern the implied-odds rule; one is in user-approved text (Q-2) and one in A-5 text. No BLOCKER or MAJOR.
